newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kirch unit signs deal with German soccer star.
newsitem.headline: Kirch unit signs deal with German soccer star.

text.p: ISPR, which markets sports stars and is jointly owned by the Kirch Group and Axel Springer Verlag, said on Tuesday it had signed a worldwide exclusive marketing rights deal with international goalkeeper Andreas Koepke.
ISPR said the signing was a further step in the business of marketing sports stars, following its work with leading striker Oliver Bierhoff, who plays for Udinese in Italy.

"With this contract, ISPR expands its business in consulting and marketing sports stars, which started as a pilot project with Oliver Bierhoff in October 1996 and proved to be extraordinarily successful," ISPR said.

ISPR said it plans to conduct polls and market research to assess the strength of Koepke's public image and consult experts on sponsorship and the media before designing a marketing strategy for the goalie, who plays for French club Marseille.
The Munich-based ISPR owns the worldwide television rights for Germany's Bundesliga soccer league.
